headers.candidate_trace:
{n : ℕ} (Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n))
    (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℚ) (h : ℕ) (R : TypedInput n) (rs : List Input) :
    ∃ k,k≤(R.hosts.map fun H => StoredHosts.hostBound Q E H+2).sum+3 ∧
      Trace (transition (StoredEdges.encode Q) (StoredRecords.encodeWeights w) n h) k
        (.candidates (encode R::rs) (StoredEdges.encode E))
        (.candidates rs (StoredEdges.encode (updated Q E w h R)))
headers.candidates_trace:
{n : ℕ} (Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n))
    (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℚ) (h : ℕ) (rs : List (TypedInput n)) :
    ∃ k,k≤work Q w h rs E ∧
      Trace (transition (StoredEdges.encode Q) (StoredRecords.encodeWeights w) n h) k
        (.candidates (rs.map encode) (StoredEdges.encode E))
        (.halt (StoredEdges.encode (selected Q w h rs E)))

headers.hostBound_le:
{n : ℕ} (Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n))
    (H : StoredHosts.TypedInput n) (m : ℕ) (hm : E.length≤m) :
    StoredHosts.hostBound Q E H≤hostCap Q.length m H
headers.hostSum_le:
{n : ℕ} (Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n))
    (hs : List (StoredHosts.TypedInput n)) (m : ℕ) (hm : E.length≤m) :
    (hs.map fun H => StoredHosts.hostBound Q E H+2).sum≤
      (hs.map fun H => hostCap Q.length m H+2).sum
headers.updated_length_le:
{n : ℕ} (Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n))
    (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℚ) (h : ℕ) (R : TypedInput n) :
    (updated Q E w h R).length≤E.length+1
headers.work_le_input:
{n : ℕ} (Q E : List (Fin n × Fin n))
    (w : Sym2 (Fin n) → ℚ) (h m : ℕ) (rs : List (TypedInput n))
    (hm : E.length+rs.length≤m) :
    work Q w h rs E≤(rs.map (candidateCap Q.length m)).sum+1
